events.title: Casino 1 Day 1 - Diamond Man and Coin Laundering Entryway
events.summary: First Casino Visit. Accidentally discovered entryway to coin laundering system which led to organized crime gaining interest in me and a chain of events. Potentially encountered VIP people.
events.description:
## Overview

First casino visit - this started a chain reaction of follow up events which led me down a rabbit hole I did not intend to go through. This led to follow up conversations about coins and investment from a sketchy banker, apartment break ins, and multiple likely related encounters at local food places and my apartment complex.

---

## Coin Incident

Purchased cigarettes from vending machine, it dispensed $5 worth of strange coins. Took coins to cashier, put tip in jar.

I believe this was a possible entryway for laundering but may have needed a better system since I discovered it by accident. It's possible they updated this afterwards.

---

## Arrival and Table Setup

Called ahead before going to ask about getting on the list. Food took a really long time to be made and I arrived at the table later than expected. The table was a new table formed of all new guests rather than joining an existing table.

*Possible interpretations:*
- Wire tap placement during the call
- They set up the table intentionally so I would be talking to specific people, possibly having observed me previously at clubs etc.
- Purely coincidence

---

## Storytelling at Table

Told stories about crime and plans to be a billionaire. Asked if anyone had stories about Casinos and crime. Mentioned movies are typically known areas for laundering money. Talked about how the law is weird and court was long.

**Expanded detail on stories told:**

- Talked about time driving Uber - awkward OnlyFans woman meeting 'client' at motel, charging vehicle at mall when two black guys got in and police pulled up pointing rifles at them. Talked about how no one even looked at me or asked what I thought was stolen goods they left in the car. Had to get out and take it to them.
- Also talked about coworker who used to work for loan shark, forced people to pay, then worked for police, and the loan shark became mayor. Coworker gave mayor's son a ticket and got kicked off police force then went into IT.
- Asked if anyone had stories related to laundering money.
- Talked about my business plans and expectations of becoming a billionaire.

---

## Dealer Interaction

New dealer came to table, asked about my father and said father could have been mayor - odd because didn't mention father at all, and he recently was a criminal who sold meth and had a gun.

---

## Diamond Man

Diamond Man to my left decked out in:
- Huge diamond rings on every finger (pyramid shaped ~1 inch diameter)
- Giant gold watch (5-6 inch diameter)
- Grill on teeth

Not super chatty.

---

## Adderall at Table

Took an Adderall at table.

*Potential misinterpretation:* Wanting to sell drugs or launder drug money, but was just my prescribed medication.

---

## Business Talk

Talked about wanting to be a billionaire and working on multiple businesses to help kids learn and improve motivation at work (this likely brought attention to me and generated interest).

Diamond Man left after I asked him if my sandwich looked like pork (which looking back is kinda funny - could have been a cop link). Later gave advice to the person who replaced him.

---

## Cigarettes and Jackpot Machine

Also bought a pack of cigarettes, smoked one, and put the rest on one of the jackpot machines.

*Potential misinterpretation:* Signaling desire for a large payout or having a lot of money to launder - connects to 'unicorn' note at Crow Coffee, slime mug symbolism, and sharpie surveillance confirmation.

---

## Basic Cigarette

Got a cigarette from someone with label 'Basic' on it, threw it in the trash.

events.title: Harrahs Casino (Casino 2 of 2) Day 2 - Matthew/Shane Dealers, Banker, Real Estate
events.summary: Second visit to Harrahs (evening). Matching dealer names, cryptic banker investment offer, and apartment entry evidence.
events.description:
## Table Play

Second casino visit. First dealer named **Matthew** (narrator's name). Second dealer named **Shane** (narrator's middle name).

**Yellow Earbuds Man:** Sat down then left shortly after - yellow earbuds case interpreted as 'don't use words.' Replaced by thug-like man.

**Banker at Table:** Made cryptic comments about investment - rolled a green chip to narrator while saying *'I want to invest in you.'*

**Losing Chips:** Narrator was playing a hand against the new thug-style man and went all in while saying *'You know, I don't know that this is a good poker move but...'* then went all in and lost the chips to him.

## Bar Conversation

After losing chips, went to the bar. **Banker** was there. He was frustrated and said:

> 'Will you stop trying to get information out of me man.'

I was confused but thought maybe he was concerned about a wire - he also had earphones on. Alternatively could have been law enforcement trying to see if I had anything to launder (but I don't).

I asked him what his goals are (which I ask a lot of people because it's important). I said whatever your goals are break it down into small pieces and it becomes easier. He said I need to watch what I say to people, still frustrated. I assumed he was talking about the gentleman from Casino Day 1 to my left but I am not sure.

I replied and said I don't give a shit about what other people think I care about me. The banker laughed, looked at the bartender in a much better mood, and he said:

> 'Coins man, do you want me to invest in you or not?'

And the bartender brought two waters to us. The 'coins man' reference ties back to Day 1 vending machine coins being taken to tip jar.

## Real Estate Conversation

After the banker conversation, went downstairs to the other bar and ordered a drink - got a Long Island. Asked if they had any *'spice'* for my drink. Then approached by **Asian man** who said he's in real estate.

I asked him how the $400 million tax bill for education that passed changes things. He said it makes no impact.

**Possible interpretations:**
- He's not from around here, unfamiliar with what I was talking about
- Could have thought I meant sex or drugs, actually I was just feeling curious and it was a random comment to see if anything happened. Maybe not the brightest idea
- Definitely seemed like it meant 'where to meet' - he looked like he was waiting for something at the end of the conversation and I didn't know what he was expecting

This combined with the **green folders placed on the bed** at the apartment afterward was questionable - could indicate a sex/prostitution angle, alternatively could be investment perspective.

## Other Observations

- Two female staff positioned strangely in back

## Apartment Evidence

Went home to find:
- **Green folders** on bed (just moved from other location, not taken)
- **$20 in ones** on nightstand

The $20 in ones directly responded to 'break things into small pieces' comment.
evidence: Apartment may have evidence of entry

## Observation

The light remained on when the electrical outlet switch was turned off (which controls all power flow to the lights), AND it also didn't turn off when the power switch on the actual light fixture itself was flipped. Unknown when placed. Was removed around 12/22.

## Context

Narrator spoke in the apartment in an energetic tone about being observed by multiple parties - presumably CIA (although meant FBI), Mob, and/or Google or other corporation - saying "I don't have shit for any of them." The electricity from the lightbulb container went back to functioning as expected after this.

## Analysis

Timing may correlate with narrator's outreach for support to various entities - possibly government actors stopped monitoring after outreach, or mic was removed when narrator explicitly asked for support. Alternatively, if the mic was placed by a criminal party, the narrator mentioning potential government observation may have been interpreted as a warning - prompting them to remove the surveillance equipment.

## Consideration

This makes the criminal party removal theory more plausible.

perspectives.author: matt
perspectives.interpretation: Surveillance equipment, removed after narrator acknowledged awareness
